name: Twilight Outpost
summary: The Twilight Outpost is a fortified encampment of the Twilight's Hammer cult nestled in the southwestern sands of Silithus. Located just northwest of the ancient Scarab Wall, it serves as a staging ground where cultists conduct dark rituals to commune with and summon elemental horrors.

sections.title: A Bastion of Whispers
sections.body: Tucked away in the southwestern reaches of Silithus, the Twilight Outpost serves as one of several major cultist strongholds dotting the desert wastes. Positioned in the shadow of the colossal Scarab Wall and west of the Bronzebeard Encampment, the outpost teems with fanatical Twilight Avengers, Geolords, and Stonecallers. Under the command of leaders like Twilight Keeper Exeter and the rare Twilight Lord Everun, these zealots toil tirelessly in service of their maddening apocalyptic masters.

sections.title: The Wind Stones
sections.body: Scattered throughout the encampment are mysterious Wind Stones, varying in size from Lesser to Greater conduits. Through the use of enchanted cultist regalia and foul incantations, the cult utilizes these monoliths to tear into the elemental planes, dragging forth Abyssal commanders and elemental lords. For adventurers brave enough to infiltrate their ranks, disrupting these summonings remains one of the primary means to strike back against the cult's influence in the desert.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight Outpost located?
faq.answer: The Twilight Outpost is situated in the far southwestern corner of Silithus. It sits northwest of the ancient Scarab Wall and directly west of the dwarven Bronzebeard Encampment.

The encampment is occupied by the Twilight's Hammer cult. Its ranks include various mortal zealots such as Twilight Avengers, Geolords, Stonecallers, and Twilight Masters, overseen by leaders such as Twilight Keeper Exeter and Twilight Lord Everun.

faq.q: What are the Wind Stones found in the camp?
faq.answer: The Wind Stones—ranging from Lesser to Greater—are mystical foci used by the cult to breach the elemental planes. Cultists channel dark energies through these stones to summon potent elemental lords and Abyssal commanders into Azeroth.

faq.q: Why is the Twilight's Hammer gathered near the Scarab Wall?
faq.answer: The cult is drawn to the potent and ancient dark energies slumbering beneath Silithus. Establishing encampments near the Scarab Wall allows them to perform elemental summonings and harness the chaotic forces stirring beyond the sealed gates.

angles.text: The Twilight's Hammer corrupts and commands elemental spirits through their Wind Stones, defying the natural balance of the elements that shamans strive to preserve.
The nihilistic zealotry of the Twilight's Hammer stands as an affront to the Light, demanding holy wrath to cleanse their foul summonings from the desert.
